headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Spencer Arrighetti earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 5 and allowing 0 earned runs. The Astros also shut out the Cubs 3-0 in another game.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams. Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Arizona Diamondbacks due to a left hamstring strain. Carter Baumler has been placed on the 60-day injured list by the Texas Rangers with a right intercostal strain. Jordan Hicks has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Chicago White Sox retroactive to May 21, 2026, due to a right lat strain. Other teams have also reported injuries, including Mickey Moniak (Colorado Rockies), Jung Hoo Lee (San Francisco Giants), Burch Smith (Detroit Tigers), Ke'Bryan Hayes (Cincinnati Reds), and Yoán Moncada (Los Angeles Angels).

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Cubs 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Spencer Arrighetti earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 5 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Shut Down Phillies in Shutout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 1-0 win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of scoreless baseball. Kyle Manzardo led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Yankees 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in 6-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Kevin Gausman earning the win. Bubba Chandler led the Pirates' pitching effort, striking out 11 batters in 5.0 innings.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Iván Herrera, Alec Burleson, Jordan Walker, Bryan Torres, Victor Scott II, and Nathaniel Lowe all contributed to the Cardinals' strong performance.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, winning 3-0. Christian Walker and Kai-Wei Teng were key contributors to the Astros' win.

top_news.title: **Gurriel Jr. Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Sunday's Game**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have made a trade, sending RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money.
